name: frida-use
description: Debug, instrument, reverse engineer, and patch running programs with Frida, primarily on Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Windows debugging and instrumentation with Frida.
interface.longDescription: Windows-focused Frida workflows for debugging Python controllers, injected JavaScript and native targets; API tracing, malware analysis, reverse engineering, and reversible runtime patching. Includes executable helpers, practical examples, and Chinese/English research notes.
defaultPrompt: Use Frida Use to debug this Windows process and write a reproducible instrumentation script.
